text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle didn't show up for training,
so getting worried, I went looking around for her—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What should I do...?
I still have plenty of lip balm left...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah, training!
Ah, I completely forgot...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry...
My head was completely filled with the thought of having to use my coupon before today ended...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The discount coupon here expires today.
But I just can't seem to find anything
I actually want to buy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Hishi Miracle seemed deeply remorseful,
I simply warned her to be more careful next time.
